verdict.rationale: GitLab's own docs say it applies compliance controls in every pipeline, surfaces security findings directly in merge requests, and lets teams set MR review instructions for consistent code review standards. These point toward enforced quality and compliance checks on merge requests, but the evidence never states that custom checks can block or gate a merge. The CodeAnt AI partner integration is third-party and earns no credit. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of configurable merge checks or approval rules that block merging, custom compliance policy definition for MRs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can enforce custom quality and compliance merge checks on pull requests

citations.quote: Apply controls for compliance and collect audit-ready evidence automatically in every pipeline.
Security findings appear directly in merge requests and IDEs.
Create MR review instructions to ensure consistent and specific code review standards in your project.
